thread:
maria: Heads up — console is showing a sudden QoS drop for a bunch of tenants after the new policy mapping change. Not sure if it's a metrics mapping issue or a routing effect.
ken: Saw this too. Looks correlated with the `policy_version` -> `policy_tag` rename that hit the API yesterday.
sam: Are SDKs sending the old header still? That could cause the server to fall back to default low-QoS route.
tj: Python and TS clients were updated in the last minor release to send `x-rd-policy-tag` but Go has a delayed roll. Go -> old header `x-rd-policy-version` still in prod for some customers.
alex: Quick repro: curl shows request with `x-rd-policy-version: control-v1` gets routed to a lower-priority route. curl with `x-rd-policy-tag: control-v1` hits the high-QoS pool.
maria: Ok so mismatch in header name -> inconsistent routing. That explains the QoS noise. Any chance we can make the server accept both headers for a grace window?
ken: We can add a server-side compatibility layer to shadow the old name into the new field for 2 weeks. Low risk. I'll file a small PR for the route-negotiator.
sam: Also console dashboards are keyed by `policy_tag`. For tenants still sending the old header, their traffic shows up under "unknown" in the dashboard which tripped alerts. We should backfill a mapping for the last 48h so customers don't get false alerts.
tj: For SDKs: recommend we publish a hotfix for Go to start sending new header ASAP. Python/TS already in latest stable but some customers pin old versions. Maybe we should add a runtime fallback in SDKs that sends both headers (new + old) for one release to avoid breakage. Thoughts?
alex: Sending both headers seems harmless and would buy time. But double-headers might confuse some downstream proxies; we should only send both when local config says `enable_compat_headers=true`. That way opt-in and we can flip it on for e.g., platform-assisted rollouts.
maria: Good call. Action items: 1) ken to add server shim that accepts old header and maps to `policy_tag` (PR by EOD) 2) sam to backfill dashboard mappings for last 48h and mute the noisy alerts for impacted tenants 3) tj to ship Go hotfix ASAP + SDK change to add opt-in dual-header behavior 4) we announce a deprecation timeline and a brief migration doc in devex.
ken: I'll open the PR and include tests for both headers. Will also add a feature flag `accept_old_policy_header` in case we need to roll it back.
sam: Working on the backfill now. Will coordinate with infra for extra ingestion capacity during the job.
tj: I'll cut the Go fix and an opt-in patch release. Also will add a short README snippet for integrators.
alex: I'll prepare the console-side mute and add an annotation in the dashboard that shows "policy header mapping in flight" so support sees context.
deploy-bot: deploy started — route-negotiator/shim v2.1.3 -> canary (us-west)
maria: Thanks everyone. Let's sync in #incident-postmortems after we stabilize to draft the migration timeline and next steps for customers. :thumbsup:
